name: In-N-Out Burger Plain Hamburger (Standard Bun, Plain)
whyItWorks: Made with a fresh 100% chuck patty grilled to order and served on an old-fashioned toasted sponge-dough white bun. Ordered plain, it has zero dairy, zero onion fructans, zero tomato acid, and zero pickle seeds.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: "Hamburger, plain: meat and bun only. No spread, no lettuce, no tomato, no onion."
